---
title: "Factor Fields in FORWARD Data"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(hercwidpi)

WISEDASH_DIR <- hiRx::input_path("Iterations",
                                 "WISEDash")

file_checksum <- function(.x) {
    WISEDASH_DIR |> file.path(.x) |> tools::md5sum()
}

```

```{r}
#| label: import-forward-info
#| cache-extra: !expr "file_checksum('forward.rds')"

RAW_FORWARD <- WISEDASH_DIR |>
    file.path("forward.rds") |>
    readRDS() |>
    dplyr::select(
        !tidyselect::any_of(c(
            "COUNTY",
            "DISTRICT_NAME",
            "SCHOOL_NAME"
        ))
    ) |>
    hercwidpi::recode_agency_fields()

pillar::glimpse(RAW_FORWARD)

```

```{r}
#| label: inspect-forward-factors
#| dependson:
#| - import-forward-info
#| output: asis

c(
    "AGENCY_TYPE",
    "GRADE_GROUP",
    "CHARTER_IND",
    "TEST_SUBJECT",
    "TEST_GROUP",
    "GROUP_BY",
    "GROUP_BY_VALUE"
) |>
    purrr::walk(
        \(.field) {
            cat("####", .field, "\n\n")
            RAW_FORWARD |>
                dplyr::summarize(
                    dplyr::across("SCHOOL_YEAR",
                                  list(First = dplyr::first,
                                       Last = dplyr::last),
                                  .names = "{.fn}"),
                    .by = tidyselect::all_of(.field)
                ) |>
                knitr::kable(
                    align = "lrr"
                ) |>
                print()
            cat("\n\n")
        }
    )

cat("#### Test results\n\n")
RAW_FORWARD |>
    dplyr::count(
        .data$TEST_RESULT_CODE,
        .data$TEST_RESULT,
    ) |>
    knitr::kable() |>
    print()
cat("\n\n")
```
